speaker: Patient
text: The headaches started two weeks ago and have been getting worse, especially in the mornings. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cushing's syndrome secondary to pituitary adenoma (Cushing's disease). The combination of morning headaches, visual disturbances, and confirmed hypercortisolism strongly supports this diagnosis. I recommend an MRI of the brain to locate the pituitary tumor.
